# Susie’s Jewelry Repair

> In-house jewelry and watch repair shop in Pasadena, Texas, helping customers book repairs for rings, watches, chains, bracelets, necklaces, stones, pearls, heirlooms, and custom jewelry.

Primary action: book a repair appointment. AI discovery: [AI summary](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/ai/summary.json), [service catalog](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/ai/service.json), [FAQ catalog](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/ai/faq.json), and [site guide](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/ai/site-guide).

## Repair Services

- [Watch Repair & Battery Replacement](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/watch-repair): Watch batteries, bands, crystals, crowns, stems, and movement assessment.
- [Ring Sizing & Repair](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/ring-sizing): Ring sizing up or down, fit checks, prong inspection, and refinishing guidance.
- [Stone Replacement & Settings](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/stone-setting): Stone tightening, replacement stones, prong repair, and setting work.
- [Jewelry Cleaning & Polishing](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/jewelry-cleaning): Cleaning, polishing, inspection, and care guidance.
- [Necklace Repair](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/necklace-repair): Broken chains, clasps, jump rings, charms, and soldering.
- [Bracelet Repair](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/bracelet-repair): Links, clasps, safety chains, tennis bracelets, and fit adjustments.
- [Pearl Restringing](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/pearl-restringing): Pearl restringing, knotting, clasp checks, and strand repair.
- [Custom Design](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/custom-design): Custom jewelry design, remounting stones, and redesign consultations.
- [Heirloom Restorations](https://www.susiesjewelryrepair.com/services/heirloom-restoration): Careful restoration for antique and sentimental jewelry.
